title: 3 Hour Exotic car Tour driving 4 to 5 Super cars
includes: Safety presentation and overview of each vehicle
requirements: All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb:
Drive 4 to 5 of the World’s finest and sought-after Super cars in one day while exploring beautiful Niagara wine country. GTA Exotics is the original 100% Canadian and family operated exotic car tour company and we do it best! With 22 years of industry experience.

Start and end your Tour at the beautiful Ivy Lane Estate a short 55 minutes drive from Toronto or 45 minutes from Niagara Falls.

Available cars on Automatic Tour: Lamborghini Huracan Evo, Ferrari 488 Spider, McLaren 570S, Audi R8 V10, Porsche GT3 RS, Mercedes AMG GTR, Corvette C8 Z51, Aston Martin.
Available cars on Manual transmission tour: Audi R8 Supercharged, Porsche GT4, Hellcat Challenger, Lotus Emira, Dodge Viper.

2 (two) participants per car will share the drive time & rotate through the cars together. You may choose to be a passenger in which case the driver next to you will take your drive time. 

Drivers must be 19 + and have Canadian G2, G or any foreign country driver's license.
